name: Cilegon Open 2016

venue.name: Ramen Sakura
venue.address: Cilegon City Square blok H nomor 8

information: This is a simple competition for about 50 competitors only! The registration fee for all events is IDR 70.000 for early bird (until 16 March 2016) and IDR 100.000 for on the spot. You can see more information on the website or ask the organizer.
